column1: # Known-genotype sanity set for the FKS1 (echinocandin) re-caller
# (scripts/recaller_sanity_fks1.py). The v2 analog of known_genotypes.tsv (ERG11).
# Purpose: before trusting the FKS1 reads->window-consensus->call orchestration on a 29k-isolate
# snapshot, run it on a handful of strains whose FKS1 echinocandin-resistance genotype is already
# published, and confirm the caller emits the expected panel token (S639F/P/Y). This is the FKS1
# de-risking slice named in TODOS.md (v2, OPEN step 1) and in work/RUNBOOK_fks1_run.md (step 3) --
# a fixed, citable truth set, NOT NCBI's (absent) AMR labels.
# TRUTH SET. The three POSITIVE controls (one per panel token) are drawn from the published FKS1
# benchmark dataset for C. auris (PMC12323592: "A benchmark dataset for validating FKS1 mutations
# in Candida auris"), which categorizes 100 WGS isolates as echinocandin susceptible/resistant and
# lists each resistant isolate's HS1 substitution + its SRA run. That paper exists precisely to
# validate FKS1 variant callers, so it is the ideal echinocandin analog of Lockhart 2017 (the
# ERG11 truth set). The NEGATIVE control (B11220) is the same clade-II azole/echinocandin-
# susceptible reference used in the ERG11 fixture -- reused here as an FKS1 wild-type control.
# PLATFORM + PROVENANCE (verified 2026-09-02): every run below is ILLUMINA PAIRED WGS, confirmed
# against the ENA read_run API (instrument_platform=ILLUMINA, library_layout=PAIRED,
# library_strategy=WGS, scientific_name=Candida[ozyma] auris). This is load-bearing: the
# orchestration aligns with `minimap2 -ax sr` (the short-read preset), the same path the real
# `fill` uses -- a PacBio/Nanopore run would misalign under `-ax sr` and yield an honest but
# useless uncalled, so the sanity set must not use one. Verified fields per run:
#   SRR28270963  ILLUMINA PAIRED WGS  2,111,011 reads  SAMN40300162   (B11211, S639F)
#   SRR10461137  ILLUMINA PAIRED WGS  3,785,367 reads  SAMN13294172   (B12136, S639P)
#   SRR7909222   ILLUMINA PAIRED WGS  2,834,008 reads  SAMN10139331   (B12663, S639Y)
#   SRR3883452   ILLUMINA PAIRED WGS  (Lockhart 2017; already validated in known_genotypes.tsv)
# Benchmark WGS is deposited under BioProjects PRJNA638416 / PRJNA722434 (with earlier isolates
# under PRJNA328792 / PRJNA493622 / PRJNA595978); B11220 is Lockhart 2017's PRJNA328792.
# expected_panel semantics: the FKS1 HS1 panel substitution(s) the source attributes to this
# strain -- what result['panel_hits'] must CONTAIN. Empty ("-") means echinocandin-SUSCEPTIBLE /
# FKS1 wild-type and must yield NO panel hit (a spurious S639* there means the orchestration --
# alignment/consensus -- not the science, is wrong). Only HS1 (S639F/P/Y) is panel-tagged; HS2
# (R1354) is reported but not yet tagged, so an HS2 difference is emitted verbatim, not a panel
# hit, and is not an expectation here. clade is display-only (the FKS1 genotype, not the clade,
# is the point); "-" where the source does not pin it.
# Columns (tab-separated): strain  clade  run_acc  expected_panel  note  citation
